description: B=1 Skyrme hedgehog profile F(x), massless pions, ANW conventions
conventions: L = (F_pi^2/16) Tr dU dU^dag + (1/(32 e^2)) Tr[L_mu,L_nu]^2, F_pi in the 186-MeV convention, x = e F_pi r; U = exp(i tau.rhat F), F(0) = pi
method: Chebyshev collocation on the whole half line, x = L(1+t)/(1-t), L = 2, N = 160; agrees with the box [0,40] + Robin BC + analytic tails to <1e-8
